effects.name: Big Metric + Count-Up
effects.description: The headline number. Animates up on load. Use one per view — the hero figure.

effects.name: KPI Tile + Delta
effects.description: Value with a colored change badge vs a prior period. Green up / red down / grey flat.

effects.name: KPI + Sparkline
effects.description: A value paired with a tiny inline trend line. Great in dense dashboards / table cells.

effects.name: Value to Target
effects.description: Number plus a progress-to-ceiling bar. Color shifts as you approach the limit.

effects.name: Stat Pair
effects.description: Two related figures side by side (P50/P99, before/after, plan/actual).

effects.name: Mini KPI Row
effects.description: A compact row of small KPIs for a summary strip across the top of a report.

effects.name: KPI Delta Card Grid
effects.description: A 2×2 grid of mini metric cards, each with a value and a period-over-period delta badge. The compact scorecard most dashboards open with — counts animate on load.

effects.name: Animated Count-Up Pair
effects.description: Two big figures that both count up from zero, joined by a flow arrow. Ideal for in→out, before→after, or request→response relationships. Cubic ease-out via the shared count-up engine.

effects.name: Value + Inline Trend + Delta
effects.description: The triple-decker KPI: headline number, a self-drawing sparkline beside it for context, and a delta badge for the verdict. Dense but readable — fits a dashboard tile.

effects.name: Semicircle Arc Gauge
effects.description: Classic half-gauge for a % against a max. Arc fills on load. Recolor by threshold.

effects.name: Donut Percentage Ring
effects.description: A ring that fills clockwise to a %. The center holds the value. Compact and clean.

effects.name: Score Dial + Needle
effects.description: 270° dial with a red→amber→green band and a needle. For health scores / ratings.

effects.name: Level / Battery Meter
effects.description: Vertical fill for capacity, storage, budget burn. Intuitive "how full" read.

effects.name: Bullet Chart
effects.description: Measure bar over qualitative bands with a target tick. Dense KPI-vs-goal in one line.

effects.name: Tachometer Ring + Ticks
effects.description: A full 360° ring gauge with major tick marks around the rim, like an instrument cluster. The arc fills clockwise on load and the tick set gives the eye a scale to read against.

effects.name: Radial Progress Stack
effects.description: A row of small donut gauges, each labelled, for showing several independent percentages side by side (CPU / mem / disk). Every ring fills on load from the shared .gfill animation.

effects.name: Threshold Ring (alarm)
effects.description: A progress ring that pulses red once the value crosses its alarm threshold. The breathing opacity draws the eye to a metric that needs attention without a hard blink — use for quota / budget / error-rate breaches.

effects.name: Gradient Band Speedometer
effects.description: A 180° dial whose arc runs through a green→amber→red gradient with a pointer needle. Great for any reading where "how far into the red" matters — temperature, load, risk score.

effects.name: Labeled Progress Bar
effects.description: The workhorse. Animated fill, label + % above. Add .pos for green.

effects.name: Segmented Progress
effects.description: Discrete steps / stages. Good for checklists, pipelines, maturity levels.

effects.name: Stacked Ratio Bar (100%)
effects.description: Composition of a whole in one bar with a legend. Cleaner than a pie for 2–4 parts.

effects.name: Multi-Ring (concentric)
effects.description: Several percentages at a glance (Apple-rings style). Up to ~3 before it gets noisy.

effects.name: Waffle Chart
effects.description: 100 cells = part-of-whole as countable squares. Reads as "37 in 100" instantly.

effects.name: Ranked Fill Ribbon
effects.description: Stacked full-width tracks where each bar fills to its value and labels itself inline at the right edge. Colour grades by health so the worst rows read red. The fills animate in from zero width.

effects.name: Bullet Chart (banded)
effects.description: Stephen Few's bullet graph: a thin measure bar over qualitative range bands with a target tick. Replaces a whole gauge in one line — the dense way to show "where are we against goal?". Measure bar grows from the left.

effects.name: Line Chart
effects.description: Self-drawing trend line with gridlines + axis. The default for a metric over time.

effects.name: Area Chart
effects.description: Line with a gradient fill underneath — emphasizes volume / cumulative magnitude.

effects.name: Column / Bar Trend
effects.description: Discrete periods (months, weeks). Highlight the latest bar in a lighter shade.

effects.name: Range / Min-Max Bars
effects.description: High-low whiskers with a marker — latency ranges, price bands, daily spread.

effects.name: Sparkline + Figure
effects.description: Axis-free micro-trend under a single number. Perfect inside cards and table rows.

effects.name: Sparkline Grid (small multiples)
effects.description: A tidy grid of mini metric cards, each pairing a current value with its own micro-trend. The "small multiples" pattern — scan many KPIs and their direction in one glance without a single axis label.

effects.name: Stacked Area Chart
effects.description: Several series stacked into bands so the total reads as the top edge while each layer shows its own contribution over time. Layers fade up in sequence on load. Best for composition-of-a-growing-whole.

effects.name: Box / Whisker Trend
effects.description: Per-period spread shown as a whisker with a median marker, latest period highlighted. Reads min/median/max at once — perfect for latency distributions or daily price bands across weeks.

effects.name: Horizontal Bar Ranking
effects.description: Top-N by value, sorted, longest first. The clearest "what's biggest" view.

effects.name: Heatmap Grid
effects.description: Density over two dimensions (day × hour, region × service). Opacity = intensity.

effects.name: Grouped Bars
effects.description: Two series per category (plan vs actual, this year vs last). Keep groups ≤ 6.

effects.name: Dot / Lollipop Plot
effects.description: Less ink than bars for comparing a single value across many categories.

effects.name: Slope Chart
effects.description: Two time points joined by lines — the slope instantly shows who rose and who fell between periods. Cuts through the clutter of grouped bars when you only care about the change. Lines draw in from the left.

effects.name: Diverging Bar Chart
effects.description: Bars grow left or right from a shared zero axis so positive and negative changes split cleanly to either side. The natural pick for net deltas, sentiment, or capacity gained vs lost. Bars expand from the centre line.

effects.name: Waterfall Chart
effects.description: Floating bars connected by step lines that show how an opening value reaches a closing value through sequential additions and subtractions. The standard for MRR bridges, budget variance, and headcount flows. Bars fade up left to right.

effects.name: Status Pills
effects.description: State at a glance with a glowing dot. Color carries the meaning; text confirms it.

effects.name: Traffic Light
effects.description: Three-state indicator where only one lamp is lit. Familiar, unambiguous.

effects.name: Threshold Band Meter
effects.description: Where a value sits inside OK / warn / critical zones. Marker shows current reading.

effects.name: Live Ticker
effects.description: A pulsing "live" dot beside a counting figure. Signals real-time / streaming data.

effects.name: Uptime Status Strip
effects.description: One slim bar per day coloured by health (the "status page" classic). Green is up, amber degraded, red an incident — a month of reliability scannable in a single row with no axis needed.

effects.name: Pulsing Health Beacon
effects.description: Concentric rings that breathe in opacity around a central verdict — a calm "all systems normal" heartbeat for a status hero. Swap the colour token to flip the whole beacon to warn or critical.

effects.name: Health Score Chip — Green
effects.description: A single 0–100 health score whose entire chip — number, border, badge — takes its colour from the band it lands in. Green ≥ 80 = healthy. Swap the modifier class to recolor everything at once.

effects.name: Health Score Chip — Amber
effects.description: The same chip in its warning band (40–79) — "kinda bad / watch it." Amber means attention but not an outage. The verdict word and dot follow the colour automatically.

effects.name: Health Score Chip — Red
effects.description: Critical band (< 40) — page someone. The whole component is driven by one colour token so a JS threshold check is the only logic you need to flip green → amber → red.

effects.name: RAG Zone Meter
effects.description: Maps a raw value onto green / amber / red zones with a marker showing exactly where it sits. The zones can be unequal (here red is the narrow danger end). Reads the verdict from position, not colour memory.

effects.name: api-gateway
effects.description: A service roster where each row owns its colour via a modifier class — a glowing dot, the value, and (if you like) the name all tint together. The classic "what's red right now" rollup table.

effects.name: RAG Service Dot-Grid
effects.description: Every service as a coloured cell — green healthy, amber degraded, red critical (the critical ones blink). Scales to dozens of services in a tile; the eye jumps straight to red.

effects.name: Health Thermometer
effects.description: A vertical gauge whose fill gradient runs green→amber→red as it climbs, with the current reading and band beside it. Ideal for a saturating resource — pressure, temperature, queue depth.

effects.name: Segmented Readiness
effects.description: A stepped bar that fills N-of-M segments and colours the whole set by the band the ratio falls in. Great for "checks passed", maturity level, or a star-style rating with a verdict colour.

effects.name: SLO Error-Budget Ring
effects.description: How much of the month's error budget remains, the ring recoloured by band — green plenty, amber thin, red blown. The SRE's go/no-go-for-deploys gauge.

effects.name: Letter-Grade Scorecard
effects.description: A pillar-by-pillar report card (Well-Architected style) where each cell is graded A–F and tinted by band. Turns a multi-dimension assessment into one scannable colour block.

effects.name: Threshold Progress Bar
effects.description: A utilization bar whose fill blends green→amber→red along its length, paired with a verdict pill. The fill colour at the tip tells you the band without reading the number.

effects.name: RAG Gauge + Needle
effects.description: A speedometer with a red→amber→green sweep and a needle parked in the band. The continuous gradient track plus discrete verdict word gives both the precise position and the call.

effects.name: 300-VM Fleet Health Grid ★ hero
effects.description: The answer to "how do I show 300 VMs?" — one tiny cell per host in a dense grid, coloured by health. The handful of critical hosts pulse with an expanding red ring so they pop out of a sea of green instantly. Scales to thousands; hover/click would drill in. This is the at-a-glance fleet status board.

effects.name: Server Rack View
effects.description: Hosts as rack units with a status LED and a load readout — the critical unit's border and lamp glow red and blink. Mirrors the mental model of a physical rack; good for a single cabinet or AZ.

effects.name: Node Heat-Grid (128)
effects.description: A medium-density variant — 128 nodes where colour encodes load rather than a hard state, so hot spots emerge as warm clusters. Same primitive as the 300-VM board at a different scale and encoding.

effects.name: Severity Bubble-Pack
effects.description: Each failing host is a bubble sized by blast-radius and coloured by severity, packed together. Big red bubbles = your worst problems; tiny ambers = noise. Triage by area, not by reading a list.

effects.name: Capacity Treemap
effects.description: Fleet sliced into rectangles sized by host count per service and tinted by health — the biggest red rectangle is where the most capacity is hurting. Packs a whole estate into one frame.

effects.name: Top Offenders List
effects.description: Once the grid says "something's red," this ranks the worst hosts with a mini severity bar so you know which to open first. The grid finds them; the list orders them.

effects.name: Structured Log Viewer
effects.description: Monospace log lines with timestamp, level (color-coded), message, and source. Scrollable container with hover highlight.

effects.name: HTTP Access Log (colored)
effects.description: Access log style with color per status code. Green 2xx, amber slow, red 5xx.

effects.name: Log Level Summary
effects.description: Badge counts per severity plus a proportional bar. At-a-glance error rate.

effects.name: Error Rate Sparkline + Threshold
effects.description: Time-series of error rate with a threshold line and spike annotation. For alerting context.

effects.name: Live Streaming Log (tail -f)
effects.description: A console that appends a fresh line every tick and scrolls the old ones up under a fade — the live tail -f feel. Levels are colour-coded and a blinking cursor sits on the newest line. Continuously animated.

effects.name: Search + Grep Highlight
effects.description: A query types itself into the box, then matching log lines reveal one by one with the matched term highlighted in-place. The "searching your logs" moment — type, match, highlight. Loops.

effects.name: Log Scan Beam
effects.description: A glowing scanline sweeps top-to-bottom over a block of log lines while anomalies stay flagged in red — the "analyzing / inspecting logs" indicator for an automated triage step. Pure CSS loop.

effects.name: Search Facets
effects.description: The faceted sidebar of a log explorer — each filter shows its match count and a proportional bar that grows on load, so you see which dimension narrows the haystack fastest before you even click.

effects.name: Session Timeline
effects.description: Vertical timeline of events within a single AI session. Color-coded dots for OK/warn/error/active states.

effects.name: Session Waterfall
effects.description: Gantt-style waterfall of a session's calls and tool executions. Shows sequential timing and parallelism.

effects.name: Session Cost Per Turn
effects.description: Bar chart of cost per turn in a session. Quickly spot which turns are expensive.

effects.name: Error Trace (Linked Files)
effects.description: Trace an error through multiple source files with severity, filename, line number, and message at each hop.

effects.name: Distributed Trace Span
effects.description: Multi-service trace waterfall showing parent-child spans. Like Jaeger/X-Ray but as inline SVG.

effects.name: Stack Trace Viewer
effects.description: Formatted stack trace with highlighted source files vs vendor frames. Clickable file links.

effects.name: Donut Chart
effects.description: Ring donut with center value and legend. Best for 2–5 categories of a total.

effects.name: Pie Chart (5 segments)
effects.description: Classic filled pie. Use sparingly — harder to compare angles than bars. Max 5 slices.

effects.name: Success/Fail Ring
effects.description: Two-segment donut optimized for pass/fail, success/error ratios. Green dominates when healthy.

effects.name: 3D Bar Chart (isometric)
effects.description: Isometric-perspective bar chart with floor grid and top highlights. Pure SVG, no WebGL.

effects.name: 3D Pie Chart
effects.description: Extruded 3D pie with depth/shadow. Eye-catching for executive decks. 2–3 slices max.

effects.name: 3D Area / Mountain
effects.description: Area chart with depth shadow creating a 3D mountain effect. Dramatic for single-series trends.

effects.name: 3D Surface / Mesh Plot
effects.description: Wireframe surface for two-variable metrics (e.g. latency across region × hour). Height-shaded quads convey the third dimension. Best for showing a "landscape" of values.

effects.name: 3D Scatter (depth cue)
effects.description: Bubble scatter where size and opacity encode the z-axis (depth toward the viewer). Plots three metrics at once — cost vs usage vs risk. Floor + back walls anchor the space.

effects.name: 3D Stacked Bars (isometric)
effects.description: Multi-series stacked columns rendered with extruded depth. Each segment shows a front face, lit top, and shadowed side. Great for cost breakdowns by category over periods.

effects.name: 3D Cylinder Bars
effects.description: Rounded cylindrical columns with lit top caps and curved side shading. A softer, more "physical" alternative to flat bars for utilization gauges.

effects.name: 3D Voxel Heatmap
effects.description: Isometric grid of extruded tiles where both color intensity and pillar height encode the metric. Reads as a "city skyline" of activity — ideal for service × time density.

effects.name: 3D Layered Ribbon Lines
effects.description: Stacked, receding area-lines on parallel z-planes — a depth-sorted way to compare the same trend across several years or cohorts without overlap clutter.

effects.name: 3D Globe / Edge Map
effects.description: Shaded sphere with lat/long wireframe and surface nodes. Conveys global distribution — edge PoPs, regional traffic, or worldwide active users — at a glance.

effects.name: 3D Donut / Torus Gauge
effects.description: Extruded ring gauge with a visible side wall for depth and a colored segment marker. A premium-looking single-value progress indicator for dashboards and decks.

effects.name: 3D Pillars on Tilted Plane
effects.description: Columns rising from a perspective floor grid, each with front/top/side faces. The receding plane gives a strong sense of depth for ordered series like weekly counts.

effects.name: 3D Extruded Radar Prism
effects.description: A radar/spider polygon extruded into a solid prism. The depth makes a multi-axis score (performance, cost, security, scale, reliability) feel tangible in exec reviews.

effects.name: 3D Cylinder Bars
effects.description: Rounded columns built from a body rectangle capped by a lit top ellipse and a soft base shadow — the spreadsheet-classic "3-D cylinder" chart. Bars rise on load. Great for a small set of named totals.

effects.name: 3D Scatter / Bubble Cloud
effects.description: Bubbles floating above an isometric floor plane, each tethered by a dropline so you can read its footprint — three encoded dimensions plus size as a fourth. The big red bubble is the outlier you care about.

effects.name: 3D Stacked Bars
effects.description: Isometric columns split into stacked segments, each with its own lit top and shaded side — composition and total in one solid. Use for a few categories where the breakdown matters as much as the height.

effects.name: 3D Torus Donut
effects.description: A tilted ring with a highlight rim and shaded tube to read as a 3-D torus, the arc filling to a percentage on load. A richer alternative to the flat donut for a single hero ratio.

effects.name: 3D Ribbon Line
effects.description: A time series drawn as a thick ribbon with a visible side face, giving a single trend physical depth as it winds across the plot. The highlight stroke self-draws. Good as a section hero for one headline metric over time.

effects.name: 3D Globe (regions)
effects.description: A shaded sphere with a lat/long graticule and pulsing region nodes — green/amber/red by health. The wireframe slowly rotates. The go-to for "traffic / status by geography" across a global footprint.

effects.name: 3D Column Matrix
effects.description: A full grid of isometric columns — a 3-D bar field where both position (region × time) and height (volume) carry meaning. The tallest, brightest pillars are your peaks. Built procedurally from a small data array.

effects.name: 3D Funnel
effects.description: Conversion stages as tapering 3-D slabs with elliptical caps, narrowing toward the goal. The depth makes the drop-off between stages feel physical — a favourite for growth/marketing decks.

effects.name: Radar / Spider Chart
effects.description: Multi-dimensional comparison (5-8 axes). Shows strengths/weaknesses of a system or team at a glance.

effects.name: Funnel Chart
effects.description: Narrowing stages for conversion / pipeline analysis. Percentages on the right for drop-off rates.

effects.name: Flame Chart
effects.description: CPU profiler flame chart showing call hierarchy and time. Each row = one stack depth level. Width = time consumed.

effects.name: Sankey / Flow Diagram
effects.description: Shows flow of quantities between categories (spend → region, traffic → service). Width = magnitude.

effects.name: Treemap
effects.description: Area-proportional rectangles for hierarchical data. Bigger boxes = bigger cost/usage. Great for "where does the money go?"

effects.name: Multi-Line Comparison
effects.description: Multiple series on one chart with inline labels. Compare trends side-by-side. Dashed for projected.

effects.name: Scatter Plot + Trend Line
effects.description: Two-variable correlation plot. Bubble size can encode a 3rd dimension. Trend line shows direction.

effects.name: Candlestick Chart
effects.description: OHLC (open/high/low/close) candles for time-series with range data — cost variability, latency spreads, price.

effects.name: Calendar Heatmap
effects.description: The GitHub contribution grid — one cell per day, opacity encoding intensity, weeks running left to right. Reveals weekly rhythms and streaks that a line chart would smooth away. Cells are generated by a small inline loop.

effects.name: Hour × Day Matrix Heatmap
effects.description: A two-dimensional density grid (weekday down, hour across) where colour intensity shows load. The fastest way to spot peak windows and quiet maintenance slots. Cells generated inline with deterministic intensities.

effects.name: Histogram + Density Curve
effects.description: Binned frequency bars with a smoothed density curve overlaid and a median marker. Shows the shape of a distribution — where latency clusters, whether it is skewed, where the long tail lives.

effects.name: Overlapping Density (KDE)
effects.description: Two smoothed distribution curves overlaid to compare populations — old build vs new, region A vs B. The shift of the peak and the overlap between curves tell the story at a glance.

effects.name: Bump Chart (rank over time)
effects.description: Tracks how items trade ranking positions across periods — lines cross when one overtakes another. The expressive way to show a leaderboard's churn (top services, regions, models) where absolute values matter less than order. Lines draw in left to right.

effects.name: Chord / Arc Diagram
effects.description: Entities sit on a ring; ribbons inside it show how much flows between each pair. Built for relationships and mutual exchange — service-to-service calls, migration between tiers, who talks to whom. Hover fades the ribbons to isolate one.

effects.name: Arc Connection Diagram
effects.description: Nodes on a single baseline joined by semicircular arcs above — a one-line network graph. Arc height scales with distance so dependencies and call chains read without the tangle of a force layout.

effects.name: Squarified Treemap
effects.description: Nested rectangles sized by value with gradient fills, laid out so cells stay close to square for easy area comparison. The go-to for "where does it all go?" across a budget, a disk, or a codebase.

effects.name: Live ECG Monitor
effects.description: A real-time line monitor that scrolls right-to-left as fresh samples arrive — the classic "vitals" trace for CPU, latency or throughput. Glowing leading dot marks the newest reading.

effects.name: Streaming Equalizer
effects.description: A bank of bars that re-height on every tick with a springy ease — live request volume per shard, or audio-style activity. Continuously animated, never static.

effects.name: Live Gauge + Needle
effects.description: A speedometer-style dial whose needle and colored arc swing to each new value with an overshoot spring. Reads green→amber→red as the metric climbs toward its ceiling.

effects.name: Live Leaderboard
effects.description: A ranked scoreboard whose rows reorder, bars slide and values roll as live data lands — top services by spend, regions by traffic. The reorder animation makes movement obvious.

effects.name: Live Donut Ring
effects.description: A single-value ring that animates its arc and recolors on each update — success rate, SLO budget, capacity used. The center number rolls in sync with the sweep.

effects.name: Scrolling Area Stream
effects.description: A filled area chart that scrolls as new points push in from the right — throughput over a moving window. The gradient fill gives it weight; the window keeps it readable.

effects.name: Live Progress + ETA
effects.description: A determinate progress bar with a moving stripe, live throughput and a counting-down ETA — long-running jobs, deploys, backfills. Resets and loops so you can see the full cycle.

effects.name: Radar Sweep
effects.description: A continuously-rotating conic sweep over a range-ring backdrop — a "scanning / discovering" indicator for health checks, asset discovery or polling. Pure CSS, infinite loop.

effects.name: Live Stacked Bars
effects.description: A row of stacked-composition bars where each segment grows/shrinks live — request mix (2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx) per minute, cost by service over time. Shows both total and breakdown moving together.

effects.name: Rose / Nightingale (polar area)
effects.description: Wedges share equal angles but vary in radius by value — Florence Nightingale's coxcomb. Each petal blooms from the center on load. Best for cyclical categories (months, hours) where area, not length, carries the weight.

effects.name: Radial Bar Chart
effects.description: Bars wrapped into concentric arcs around a common center — a compact ranking where each track is one category and arc length is its value. Arcs sweep in on load. Reads like a circular bar chart.

effects.name: Pyramid Chart
effects.description: Stacked trapezoid tiers narrowing toward the apex (or widening to the base) — hierarchy, maturity levels, or a marketing funnel read top-down. Tiers rise into place. Distinct from the funnel: tiers are equal-angle slabs, not volume-scaled.

effects.name: Population Pyramid / Tornado
effects.description: Mirrored horizontal bars splitting left/right from a shared axis — classic for age/sex demographics, or A-vs-B comparisons (this region vs that). Bars grow outward from the spine. Also the shape of a tornado sensitivity chart.

effects.name: Venn / Set Overlap
effects.description: Overlapping translucent circles whose intersections show shared membership — features by plan tier, hosts hitting multiple limits, audiences. Uses screen blending so overlaps brighten. Circles fade in staggered.

effects.name: Connected Bubble Callouts
effects.description: Value-sized circles linked by connectors — the "key stats" cluster from infographic decks. Bubble area encodes magnitude; links imply relationship or sequence. Each pops in on a slight delay.

effects.name: Pictograph / Unit Chart
effects.description: A 10×10 grid of icons where the filled count equals the percentage — isotype-style "one symbol = one unit" counting. Concrete and friendly for non-technical audiences. Units fade in sequentially.

effects.name: Streamgraph (wiggle)
effects.description: Stacked bands flowing around a free-floating central baseline rather than a flat axis — the organic "stream" form for many categories shifting over time. Unlike the stacked-area chart, the wiggle baseline minimizes distortion so each layer's own shape stays readable.

effects.name: Network / Node-Link Graph
effects.description: Nodes joined by edges — service dependency maps, call graphs, topology. Node size encodes importance, colour encodes health; edges draw themselves then nodes pop in. The go-to for "what talks to what."

effects.name: Spiral Chart
effects.description: A time series wound into an Archimedean spiral so a long, periodic series (a year of daily values) fits one frame and seasonality lines up radially. The path self-draws from the center outward.

effects.name: Marimekko / Mekko
effects.description: A stacked bar chart where column widths also vary — so both axes carry a proportion (segment share × category size). Two dimensions of share in one block; ideal for market = segment × tier revenue.

effects.name: Bar + Line Combo (dual-axis)
effects.description: Bars for a volume metric with a line tracking a rate or ratio on a second axis — revenue vs margin, requests vs error-rate. The two encodings keep related-but-different scales legible together. Bars rise, line self-draws.

effects.name: Chernoff Faces
effects.description: Each host maps several metrics onto facial features — mouth curve = health, eye size = load, brow angle = error rate. The brain reads expressions instantly, so a wall of faces turns multivariate telemetry into a gut sense of "who's unhappy." A happy → worried → alarmed row shown here.

effects.name: Cycle Plot
effects.description: Time series split into seasonal sub-series — every Monday's hourly curve grouped, then Tuesday's, etc. — each panel sharing a mean reference line. Strips out day-to-day noise to expose the real within-cycle pattern and whether the trend per slot is rising or falling.

effects.name: Nested Treemap
effects.description: Treemap with an extra level — outer rectangles are groups (env, team, account), each subdivided into children sized by resource use. Resource hogs visibly swell and crowd their neighbours, so hundreds of processes stay monitorable in one frame.

effects.name: Radar Chart
effects.description: Multi-axis spider plot for comparing a profile across 5+ dimensions. The web breathes as values update.

effects.name: Bubble Chart
effects.description: Three dimensions at once — x, y, and size. Bubbles gently breathe to signal a live plot.

effects.name: Candlestick
effects.description: OHLC candles with wicks — green up, red down. The staple for price / range over time.

effects.name: Gantt Timeline
effects.description: Overlapping task bars across a shared timeline — project phases, deploy windows, span durations.

effects.name: Funnel Chart
effects.description: Conversion drop-off stage by stage — signups → activated → paid. Each band scales in.

effects.name: Radial Progress
effects.description: A single circular progress arc that draws to its value on load. Clean stand-in for a percentage.

effects.name: Polar Area
effects.description: A slowly-rotating polar segmentation — parts of a whole where each wedge angle carries meaning.

effects.name: Calendar Heat
effects.description: A two-week activity grid — cell opacity encodes intensity. The GitHub-contributions read.

effects.name: Step Line
effects.description: A stepped trend that holds each value until the next change — config versions, tier levels, rate steps.

effects.name: Beeswarm
effects.description: Every data point plotted without overlap — distribution shape you can actually see, points and all.

effects.name: Dumbbell Plot
effects.description: Before-vs-after for each row — the gap between the two dots is the change you care about.

effects.name: Progress Ring Set
effects.description: Three labelled mini-donuts side by side for independent percentages — CPU / mem / disk at a glance.

effects.name: Heat Matrix
effects.description: Density over two axes — hour × day, region × service. Cell opacity reads as intensity.

effects.name: Histogram
effects.description: Frequency distribution in bins — latency spread, response sizes. Bars grow from the baseline.

effects.name: Error Budget
effects.description: SLO burn bar — green to red as the budget depletes. The SRE's "how much room is left" read.

effects.name: Percentile Band
effects.description: A median line inside a p10–p90 band — shows the spread of a metric over time, not just the average.

effects.name: Cohort Retention
effects.description: Retention triangle — each row a cohort, each column a week, colour fading as users churn.

effects.name: Sunburst
effects.description: Hierarchical parts-of-a-whole in concentric rings — drill from category to subcategory outward.

effects.name: Network Graph
effects.description: Nodes and edges for topology — service maps, dependencies, clusters. Nodes pulse as they activate.

effects.name: Streamgraph
effects.description: Stacked flowing bands around a center baseline — composition of a whole shifting over time.

effects.name: Ridgeline
effects.description: Overlapping density curves stacked down the page — compare many distributions in a compact strip.

effects.name: Marimekko
effects.description: Variable-width stacked columns — segment share and category size in one two-dimensional mosaic.

effects.name: Live Pulse Line

effects.name: Waterfall Bridge

effects.name: Sparkbar Rows

effects.name: Gauge Cluster

effects.name: Labelled Donut

effects.name: Horizon Bands

effects.name: Strip Plot

effects.name: Slope Chart

effects.name: Area Chart

effects.name: Pie (3-slice)

effects.name: Extruded Pie Cylinder

effects.name: 3D Scatter Cube

effects.name: Layered Depth Area

effects.name: 3D Dot Globe

effects.name: Prism KPI

effects.name: Tilted Card Stack

effects.name: Extruded 3D Donut

effects.name: 3D Stacked Columns

effects.name: 3D Heat Voxels

effects.name: 3D Radar Plane

effects.name: 3D Funnel Cone

effects.name: KPI Carousel

effects.name: 3D Surface Mesh

effects.name: 3D Ribbon Trend

effects.name: Violin Plot

effects.name: Bullet Chart

effects.name: Sankey Mini

effects.name: Chord Diagram

effects.name: Radial Bar Race

effects.name: Waffle Chart

effects.name: Sparkline Matrix

effects.name: Contribution Stream

effects.name: Glow Border

effects.name: Confetti

effects.name: Spring Bounce

effects.name: Gravity Drop

effects.name: Morph Star

effects.name: Breathe Border
effects.description: Border radius + color intensity breathe together. Subtle "alive" signal.

effects.description: A drifting rainbow film tinted by the element's own color, with a diagonal sheen sweeping across like a holographic sticker. Premium, eye-catching — hero cards, "featured" callouts. Needs a solid card surface.

effects.description: Brushed-metal foil ribbon that catches a moving highlight in the element color. Reads as a luxe trading-card / certificate finish on badges and pills.

effects.name: Scanline-Roll
effects.description: Tight CRT raster lines that drift continuously downward, tinted by the element color and screen-blended so they sit on top of content. Subtle "old monitor / live video" texture for terminal and feed panels.

effects.name: Scan-Beam
effects.description: A single bright bar sweeps top-to-bottom across a faint raster — like a document scanner or a security camera refresh. Pairs with "scanning / verifying / processing" states.

effects.description: The classic tube power-up: the element collapses to a thin bright line, snaps open with a horizontal overshoot, then settles into a tiny periodic jitter. Great for elements that mount/appear. Plays once on load, then idles.

effects.name: Aurora-Border

effects.name: Comet-Trail
effects.description: A glowing comet head with a fading tail orbits around the card, leaving a colored streak. More dimensional than the flat Comet-Border — the light actually circles the element. One hero card at a time.

effects.name: Conic-Gradient-Border

effects.name: Sheen-Sweep
effects.description: A glossy diagonal highlight glides across the surface, then rests before repeating — like light catching a glass card. Subtle premium polish for buttons, badges, and feature cards. Tinted faintly by --c on the trailing edge.

effects.name: Noise-Grain

effects.name: Depth-Parallax

effects.name: Ripple-on-Hover

effects.name: Spotlight-Follow

effects.name: Heartbeat
effects.description: A double-thump scale pulse like a cardiac beat. For live/critical cards that should feel alive.

effects.name: Jelly
effects.description: Squash-and-stretch wobble with elastic overshoot. Playful attention-grab for a single element.

effects.name: Neon Flicker

effects.name: Hologram

effects.name: Frost

effects.name: Ember Rise

effects.name: Glint

effects.name: Orbit Dot

effects.name: Underline Grow

effects.name: Warp

effects.description: Two cyan/magenta clones slice the word into horizontal bands that jump and re-slice. The classic cyberpunk error. Requires a matching data-text attribute.

effects.name: RGB-Split
effects.description: Red and blue channel clones shake against the base word in screen blend, like a misaligned CRT. Subtler than full glitch. Requires data-text.

effects.name: Signal-Tear
effects.description: The word stays put then snaps into a quick skew shear and back — like a torn video frame. No data-text needed; one word looks best.

effects.name: Corrupt-Jitter
effects.description: Constant micro-shake plus a periodic blur smear — reads as unstable / failing data. Pairs with error and "signal lost" states.

effects.name: Shudder
effects.description: A tight high-frequency tremor with no color tricks — nervous, alarming energy. Great on monospace codes and error strings.

effects.name: Typewriter
effects.description: A stepped width animation plus a blinking caret types the line out then backspaces. Pure CSS (no JS). Tune the steps() count to the character length.

effects.name: Wipe-Reveal
effects.description: A left-to-right clip-path wipe uncovers the word, then reverses. Clean directional reveal for headings entering view.

effects.name: Blur-Focus
effects.description: The text resolves from a heavy blur into sharp focus and back out — like a lens finding its mark. Cinematic title-card entrance.

effects.name: Mask-Rise
effects.description: A bottom-up clip-path mask reveals the word as if rising from behind a line. The bread-and-butter editorial heading reveal.

effects.name: Tracking-Expand
effects.description: Letters start crushed together and fade/spread out to normal spacing — a confident "settle into place" reveal. Animates letter-spacing.

effects.name: Cursor-Block
effects.description: A solid blinking block cursor trails the text via ::after — terminal "awaiting input" feel without a typing animation. Pair with any static label.

effects.name: Letter-Wave
effects.description: Each letter bobs up and down on a staggered delay (driven by a per-span --i index the script sets), producing a rolling wave. Add data-split so the splitter wraps each character.

effects.name: Letter-Bounce
effects.description: Letters hop up in sequence like a ball skipping along the word. Playful, energetic — loading copy and friendly headings.

effects.name: Rubber-Stretch
effects.description: Each glyph squashes and stretches vertically in turn — elastic, cartoony bounce. Great for fun product names and game UI.

effects.name: Letter-Flip
effects.description: Letters rotate a full turn on the X axis one after another, like split-flap boards. Eye-catching for short words and counters.

effects.name: Color-Runner
effects.description: A wave of full color sweeps through dimmed letters — like a highlight running across the word. No movement, just traveling brightness.

effects.name: Jelly-Sway
effects.description: Letters tilt-rock around their base in a staggered sway, like wobbling jelly. Soft, organic motion for whimsical branding.

effects.name: Gold-Shine premium
effects.description: A warm gold gradient with bright highlight bands that sweep across the letters like polished metal catching light. Intentionally fixed gold palette. Awards, premium tiers, "winner".

effects.name: Chrome
effects.description: A cool steel gradient with a hot white reflection streak gliding through — liquid-metal headline. Pairs with retro/80s and automotive themes.

effects.name: Silver-Sheen
effects.description: A lighter, brighter brushed-silver sweep — subtler than Chrome. Clean metallic emphasis that still reads on the dark theme.

effects.name: Holographic-Foil
effects.description: An iridescent pink/blue/teal/gold gradient drifts through the glyphs with a soft glow — trading-card holo-foil. Multi-hue by design. Showcase/collectible vibe.

effects.name: Copper-Polish
effects.description: A rich copper/bronze gradient with a peach highlight sweep — warmer than gold, more industrial. Steampunk and artisanal branding.

effects.name: Frosted-Glass
effects.description: Near-transparent fill with a bright rim stroke and a colored under-glow, so the type reads like etched glass. Static; best over a busy/colored backdrop.

effects.name: Flame
effects.description: Stacked upward-pointing white→yellow→orange→red shadows flicker fast, so the letters appear to be on fire. Fixed flame palette. Use sparingly — high heat.

effects.name: Ice-Crystal
effects.description: A pale cyan/white gradient shimmers across the glyphs with a frosty glow — cold, crystalline. Pairs with "frozen / paused / cooling" states.

effects.name: Liquid-Flow
effects.description: A watery color/white gradient swirls while the word gently bobs and stretches, evoking flowing liquid. Reads in the element color plus a water highlight.

effects.name: Frost-Bite
effects.description: Icy-white letters with a soft blue rime glow and a thin bright stroke — static, like frost on glass. Calmer companion to Ice-Crystal.

effects.name: Smoke-Drift
effects.description: The word periodically softens into a faint blur and back, as if drifting through smoke. Subtle, atmospheric — moody hero titles.

effects.name: Molten-Lava
effects.description: A dark-red→orange→amber gradient churns through the letters with a hot outer glow — molten, dangerous. Fixed lava palette. Max-severity headlines.

effects.name: VHS-Tracking
effects.description: Red/cyan ghost offsets plus rolling scanlines and an occasional tracking warp — degraded VHS tape. Fixed analog colors. Retro intros and "rewind" themes.

effects.name: Synthwave
effects.description: A pink-to-cyan horizon split with scrolling scanlines clipped into the glyphs and a neon glow — 80s Miami / outrun grid. Fixed palette by design.

effects.name: Arcade-Blink
effects.description: Monospace glowing text with a hard 2-step blink — coin-op "PRESS START" energy. Reads in the element color. Great for scores and prompts.

effects.name: Old-TV
effects.description: Subtle red/blue fringing with a green phosphor glow — a calmer, static take on the analog look. Static (no motion); good for body labels.

effects.name: Print-Misregister
effects.description: Offset magenta/teal plates behind dark ink, like a misaligned CMYK print run — risograph/zine aesthetic. Static. Requires data-text.

effects.name: Weight-Morph
effects.description: The font weight animates thin↔heavy (with a tracking tweak) so the word visibly bulks up and slims down. Looks best with a variable or multi-weight font available.

effects.name: Horizontal-Stretch
effects.description: The word scales wider and back from its left edge — elastic kinetic-type feel. Pairs well with stretch/expand brand language.

effects.name: Tracking-Pulse
effects.description: Letter-spacing breathes from airy to tight, so the word expands and condenses in place. A refined, typographic kind of motion.

effects.name: Italic-Lean
effects.description: The word rocks between upright and a hard italic skew — speed/motion energy. Sport, racing, "fast" messaging.

effects.name: Zoom-Pump
effects.description: A steady scale pulse, like the word breathing toward the viewer. Simple, attention-grabbing beat for CTAs and counters.

effects.name: 3D-Rotate
effects.description: The word swivels left-right on the Y axis in perspective, like a turning sign. Dimensional kinetic title for hero sections.

effects.name: Scramble-In
effects.description: Characters flicker through random glyphs and lock into the target word left-to-right, then repeat — "hacker decrypt" effect. A tiny inline script drives the frames; set the final word in data-scramble.

effects.name: Decode-Glow
effects.description: Same scramble-to-lock resolve as above but with a soft colored glow on the monospace text — sci-fi terminal "authenticating" feel. Uses the shared data-scramble script.

effects.name: Redact-Reveal
effects.description: Letters churn through block/symbol noise before resolving — a "redacted document being unsealed" read. Same scramble engine; swap the target via data-scramble.

effects.name: Marquee-Scroll
effects.description: A seamless looping scroll with edge fade-masks, achieved by duplicating the content and translating −50%. Add the .rev modifier to scroll right. For continuity, repeat the text twice inside the inner span.

effects.name: Marquee-Reverse
effects.description: The same seamless marquee running right-to-left via the .rev modifier. Pair a forward and a reverse row for a two-direction news crawl.

effects.name: Stock-Ticker
effects.description: A bordered monospace crawl with green/red up/down tokens — a financial tape. Wrap movers in .up/.dn; duplicate the run for a seamless loop.

effects.name: Spin-3D
effects.description: The whole word rotates a full turn on the Y axis in real CSS 3D (preserve-3d + rotateY), like a swinging sign. Best on short display words.

effects.name: Extrude-Solid
effects.description: A ladder of colored offset shadows builds a solid extruded body while the block tilts left-right in perspective, so you see the 3D side face. Chunky hero titles.

effects.name: Flip-In (per letter)
effects.description: Each letter swings down into place from a −90° rotateX on a stagger, like flaps dropping flat. Add tx-perletter data-split so the splitter wraps every glyph.

effects.name: Tumble-3D
effects.description: The headline tumbles end-over-end on both X and Y axes in true 3D with a soft glow. High-energy attract-loop for a single short word.

effects.name: Cylinder-Ring
effects.description: Letters sit around a rotating cylinder in real 3D (rotateY(--a) translateZ), spinning past the viewer. Give each child span a --a angle stepping around the circle.

effects.name: Isometric-Block
effects.description: A skew plus a diagonal ladder of colored-then-dark shadows gives fat isometric block letters that gently float. Static-friendly; strong on the dark theme.

effects.name: Depth-Parallax
effects.description: Two dimmer clones sit behind the face at negative translateZ, so as the group tilts they parallax apart into layered depth. Requires a matching data-text.

effects.name: Diagonal-Sweep
effects.description: A single bright diagonal band rakes across solid colored glyphs via background-clip:text — a cleaner, angled cousin of the horizontal gradient pans.

effects.name: Conic-Spin
effects.description: A full-spectrum conic-gradient rotates its angle through the letters (animated @property angle) — the color literally spins around. Intentionally multi-hue.

effects.name: Specular-Shine
effects.description: A narrow white glare bar sweeps across the word (clipped by overflow:hidden), like light glinting off glossy signage. Reads in the element color.

effects.name: Bad-Bulb Flicker
effects.description: White-hot letters in a colored glow that cut out and re-strike on an irregular schedule — a failing sign / power-flicker read. Great on LIVE, ON AIR, REC.

effects.name: Iridescent-Foil
effects.description: An oil-slick gradient drifts while its hue rotates, so the glyphs shimmer teal→blue→pink→gold. Multi-hue by design; premium/holo-adjacent packaging vibe.

effects.name: Liquid-Fill
effects.description: A color level rises from the baseline to flood the hollow (stroked) letters, like liquid filling a glass, then drains. Animates background-size height.

effects.name: Plasma-Flow
effects.description: The element color churns through violet and blue with a soft outer bloom — energetic, electric fill. Reads primarily in --c with plasma accents.

effects.name: Glacier-Sheen
effects.description: A pale blue-white gradient glides across frosted glyphs with a bright rim stroke and cold glow — a crisper, brighter take on icy text. Fixed cool palette.

effects.name: Slice-Glitch
effects.description: Cyan and magenta clones cut the word into shifting horizontal bands that jump sideways — a sharper, blockier glitch than the datamosh. Requires data-text.

effects.name: Teletype
effects.description: A stepped-width reveal with a blinking block caret types the line, then backspaces — pure CSS, no JS. Match the steps() count and target ch width to your text length.

effects.name: Matrix-Decode
effects.description: Glyphs churn through random characters and lock into the word left-to-right, then loop — driven by the gallery's shared scramble engine. Set the target in data-scramble.

effects.name: Pendulum (per letter)
effects.description: Letters swing side to side from a top pivot on a stagger, like hanging tags in a breeze. Add tx-perletter data-split for per-glyph spans.

effects.name: Elastic-In (per letter)
effects.description: Each letter pops from zero scale with an overshoot-and-settle spring, one after another — a lively entrance. Add tx-perletter data-split.

effects.name: Blur-Focus (per letter)
effects.description: Letters resolve from a heavy blur into sharp focus in sequence, like a lens racking across the word. Add tx-perletter data-split.

effects.name: Stroke-Trace
effects.description: A left-to-right clip-path wipe draws the hollow outlined letters in as if being traced by a pen, then erases. Blueprint / signature reveal.

effects.name: Prism-Split
effects.description: Red/blue/green/violet shadow ghosts fan out from the letters like light through a prism, with a slow flicker. Multi-hue by design; chromatic-aberration look.

effects.name: Aurora-Drift
effects.description: Soft teal/blue/violet/green bands drift slowly across the glyphs with a gentle glow — calm, northern-lights ambience. Fixed cool multi-hue palette.

effects.name: Spotlight-Sweep
effects.description: A bright hotspot glides across the word, lighting each letter as it passes while the rest sit dim — a moving stage spotlight. Reads in the element color.

effects.name: Gooey-Wobble
effects.description: The word softens into a blurry blob and re-sharpens while its tracking breathes — a squishy, liquid-goo feel. Playful branding and fun states.

effects.name: Shadow-Pop
effects.description: The word lifts off the surface while its drop shadow grows and softens, then settles — a hover / levitation beat. Good for CTAs and badges.

effects.name: Underline-Sweep
effects.description: A gradient underline draws in from the left to full width and back, independent of the text fill. Animated link / nav-item emphasis.

effects.name: Hologram-Scan
effects.description: Cyan projection-style letters overlaid with fine rolling scan lines and a subtle flicker — a sci-fi hologram readout. Fixed cyan palette by design.

effects.name: Melt-Drip
effects.description: A white→color→faded vertical gradient with the word stretching taller from its top edge, like wax softening and dripping. Warm, hazard-y themes.

effects.name: Rainbow-Arc ★ hero
effects.description: The signature piece: each letter is rotated around a hidden center to bow the word into a rainbow arc, every glyph runs its own hue cycle while the whole arc slowly hue-rotates — a true moving spectrum. Pure per-letter CSS, no images. Letter positions are set by a tiny init script.

effects.name: Solid-Arc
effects.description: Same per-letter arc rig, single color. The word smiles upward along a circle; the gentle hue-rotate on the wrapper keeps it subtly alive. Good for banner-style headings that need a curved baseline.

effects.name: Frown-Arc
effects.description: The arc flipped: letters bow downward like a frown or a hanging banner. Each letter does a soft rise-and-fall bob, staggered, so the curve gently ripples. Set data-arc="frown" and the init script inverts the rotation.

effects.name: Arc-Rise
effects.description: An upward arc whose letters lift in a travelling wave, like text taking off. Combines the per-letter rotation (shape) with a staggered vertical bob (motion) for a buoyant, optimistic feel — launches, wins, "going up" metrics.

effects.name: Ring-Spin
effects.description: A full circle of text — letters evenly distributed around 360°, each rotated to sit tangent to the ring — slowly rotating as one unit like a coin or a seal. The init script lays the glyphs out around the circle; the wrapper spins.

effects.name: Counter-Seal
effects.description: A wax-seal / stamp look: ringed text rotating counter-clockwise around a center glyph. Pair two of these (one normal, one .rev) for concentric counter-rotating rings — a classic emblem effect. Reads as "official / certified / sealed."

effects.name: Half-Ring
effects.description: Text wrapping the top semicircle only — a gauge / badge ribbon arcing over a central value. Slowly oscillates instead of fully spinning so the label stays readable. Great around a KPI number or a circular progress dial.

effects.name: Sine-Wave
effects.description: Each letter sits at its own height along a sine curve, then bobs up and down with a per-letter delay so the whole word undulates like a flag of water. Baseline offsets and stagger delays are assigned by the init script from a sine function.

effects.name: Flag-Wave
effects.description: Cloth-flag motion: letters tilt and shift in a travelling ripple with perspective, as if printed on fabric caught in the wind. Staggered delays make the wave roll left-to-right. Lively for slogans and banners.

effects.name: Bounce-Hop
effects.description: A tighter, springier version of the sine wave — letters hop in sequence like a loading dot-bounce spread across a word. Same per-letter delay rig, faster cycle and bigger amplitude for a playful, energetic read.

effects.name: Spiral-In
effects.description: Letters placed along an Archimedean spiral — radius shrinks and the angle advances per glyph, winding the text inward to the center while the whole figure rotates. Hypnotic. The init script computes each letter's radius/angle.

effects.name: Vortex-Pull
effects.description: A spiral that also breathes: the figure rotates while scaling in and out, so the letters appear to be sucked toward the core and flung back. Adds a glow per letter for depth. Reads as "processing / being pulled in."

effects.name: Galaxy-Arm
effects.description: A looser spiral with more spacing between letters and a slow rotation — like a single galaxy arm of text. Same spiral math with a larger radius step, giving an airy, cosmic spread rather than a tight whirlpool.

effects.name: Heart-Fill
effects.description: Repeated words packed into a heart silhouette via clip-path, with a gradient sweeping through the letters as a moving fill. The shape is the clip; the text is the paint. Swap the repeated phrase for any sentiment.

effects.name: Star-Fill
effects.description: The same text-as-fill idea clipped to a five-point star. A diagonal gradient slides through the glyphs so the star shimmers. Perfect for ratings, awards, "featured" tiles — recognizable shape, readable wordmark.

effects.name: Triangle-Fill
effects.description: Text poured into a triangle / delta clip with a moving highlight. The narrowing top naturally crops words to a point, reinforcing the shape. Use for "change / delta / play" motifs or warning-sign silhouettes.

effects.name: Rainbow-Fill
effects.description: A filled shape whose text is painted with a full-spectrum gradient that both scrolls and hue-rotates — a moving rainbow trapped inside a star (combine with .heart/.tri too). Festive, celebratory, premium.

effects.name: Tunnel-Zoom
effects.description: Copies of the word fly toward the viewer down a 3D tunnel — each starts far away and small, scales up as it approaches, then fades past the camera. Staggered delays keep a steady stream. Hyperspace / "incoming" energy.

effects.name: Star-Crawl
effects.description: The cinematic opening-crawl: text laid on a floor plane tilted away with rotateX, scrolling up toward a vanishing point and fading at the top via a mask. Set any multi-line message. Epic intros and section headers.

effects.name: Depth-Stream
effects.description: A calmer tunnel: fewer copies, longer cycle, smaller glyphs — a steady forward "stream" rather than a frantic warp. Same z-axis zoom rig with a longer duration. Good for "loading / advancing / on the way" states.

effects.name: Path-Marquee (wave)
effects.description: True curved text: a long string follows an SVG wave <path> via <textPath>, and an <animate> on startOffset scrolls it like a marquee riding the curve. Filled with a gradient. Crisp at any size, fully offline.

effects.name: Path-Ring (circle)
effects.description: A circular <path> carries text all the way around; animating startOffset makes the words crawl around the ring forever — a true badge / record-label spin without per-letter math. Smoother than the transform-based ring.

effects.name: Path-Dome (static arc)
effects.description: Text centered over a clean semicircular arc — the classic dome heading. Centered with text-anchor="middle" at startOffset=50% so it stays put while the faint guide arc shows the curve. The whole tile can hue-shift for life.

effects.name: Text Tunnel
effects.description: Copies of a word fly straight at the camera down a true perspective tunnel — each starts far on the Z-axis, scales up, and blows past the viewer. Staggered so a steady stream never leaves the tile empty.

effects.name: 3D Ring of Text
effects.description: Letters distributed around a circle with rotateY + translateZ on a preserve-3d rotor, so the whole band turns in space — near letters large, far letters small. A genuine spinning 3D ring, not a flat circle.

effects.name: Cylinder Wrap
effects.description: A longer string wrapped onto the surface of a slightly tilted cylinder that rotates like a drum. Same translateZ ring math with a bigger radius and an rotateX tilt so you see the barrel curve.

effects.name: Text Cube
effects.description: Six labelled faces built with translateZ/rotateX/rotateY on a preserve-3d box that tumbles continuously. Each face carries its own word — a rotating word-die.

effects.name: Character Helix
effects.description: Characters climb a helix / DNA strand — each glyph gets an increasing rotateY plus a downward translateY, and the whole coil spins. Reads as a twisting double-helix of letters.

effects.name: Word Carousel
effects.description: Word panels arranged evenly around a vertical axis with rotateY + translateZ, revolving toward and away from you. A classic 3D carousel where each card is a word.

effects.name: Vanishing Marquee
effects.description: Lines of text march away from the viewer down a corridor, shrinking toward a vanishing point and fading out — a perspective marquee. Layered copies keep the corridor full.

effects.name: Spiral Staircase
effects.description: Letters descend a spiral staircase — each is rotated around the central axis, dropped a step in Y, and tilted flat with rotateX so it lies like a tread. The stair rotates as one.

effects.name: Orbiting Word Cloud
effects.description: Words positioned on the surface of a sphere via a golden-angle distribution, the whole globe slowly rotating so tags orbit front-to-back. A true 3D tag cloud.

effects.name: Letter Sphere
effects.description: Individual glyphs scattered across a rotating sphere (golden-spiral placement, each facing outward). The globe turns so letters wrap over the horizon — dense, planetary.

effects.name: Extruded Word
effects.description: A single word stacked as many translateZ layers to fake real extrusion / thickness, shaded front-to-back, gently rocking left-right so you see the volumetric side. Solid 3D lettering.

effects.name: Depth Wave
effects.description: A tilted row of letters where each glyph oscillates along the Z-axis on a staggered delay, so a wave travels through the word in depth rather than up and down. Perspective + preserve-3d.

effects.name: 3D Flip Panel
effects.description: A panel that flips 180° around Y to swap its front word for its back word, using backface-visibility so only the facing side shows. Great for status toggles.

effects.name: Triangular Prism
effects.description: Three word-faces set 120° apart around a vertical axis form a rotating triangular prism — a compact three-way message wheel built purely from rotateY + translateZ.

effects.name: Fanning Pages
effects.description: Text pages hinged on a left spine fan open and closed around Y with staggered delays, like a flip-book turning. Each page carries a word of the phrase.

effects.name: Full Circle
effects.description: A complete 360° ring of tangent letters that rotates as a flat disc around a centre glyph — a coin / seal wordmark. Distinct from the arc set: it closes the loop all the way around.

effects.name: High-Amplitude Wave
effects.description: Letters sit on a tall sine curve and swing between their baseline and its mirror, giving a big, rolling swell rather than a gentle ripple. Amplitude is set per tile via data-amp.

effects.name: Zigzag Path
effects.description: Alternating letters snap up and down into a sharp sawtooth, then invert on the beat so the zigzag flips its teeth. A jagged, electric baseline.

effects.name: Bounce Path
effects.description: Letters follow a ball-bounce baseline (a series of humps from |sin|) and each hops on a staggered spring ease, so a bounce rolls left-to-right across the word.

effects.name: Tight Spiral
effects.description: An Archimedean spiral with a small angular step and slow radial growth, coiling the text into a dense whirlpool that rotates. Hypnotic and compact.

effects.name: Loose Spiral
effects.description: The same spiral math opened up — larger step and growth for an airy, galactic-arm spread that sweeps slowly around. Roomy where the tight spiral is dense.

effects.name: Star Fill (pulsing)
effects.description: Repeated words clipped to a five-point star with a gradient sweeping through the glyphs, plus a gentle scale pulse so the star breathes. Ratings, awards, featured tiles.

effects.name: Heart Fill (beating)
effects.description: A heart silhouette (clip-path:path()) packed with a sentiment phrase and a moving gradient, given a soft beat via a scale pulse. Swap the phrase for any message.

effects.name: Arrow Fill
effects.description: Repeated text clipped to a right-pointing arrow with a gradient sliding in the direction of travel — a directional, "forward / next" wordmark.

effects.name: Triangle Fill
effects.description: Text poured into a triangle / delta whose narrowing apex crops words to a point, reinforcing the shape while a highlight slides through. Change / play / warning motifs.

effects.name: Hexagon Fill
effects.description: Words tiled inside a hexagon silhouette with a moving gradient — a tech / honeycomb / node badge. Tessellate several for a mesh look.

effects.name: Diamond Fill
effects.description: Repeated text clipped to a diamond / gem with a gradient glint sweeping across. Premium, "value / quality" silhouette that reads instantly.

effects.name: Infinity Loop
effects.description: True curved text riding a lemniscate (figure-∞) <path> via <textPath>; an <animate> on startOffset streams the words around both loops forever. Gradient-filled, crisp at any size.

effects.name: S-Curve Path
effects.description: Words follow a sweeping S-shaped Bézier and scroll along it like a ribbon on a slalom. The faint guide stroke shows the curve. Smoother than any per-letter transform.

effects.name: Figure-8 Track
effects.description: A vertical figure-eight racetrack where the text laps continuously through the crossover. Same textPath + startOffset technique, stacked instead of side-by-side.

effects.name: World Pulse Map
effects.description: Stylized continents with pulsing location dots — a global activity overview.

effects.name: US Map
effects.description: Simplified contiguous-US outline with glowing city markers and state lines.

effects.name: Europe Blob
effects.description: A single soft region blob with capital markers for a continent-level view.

effects.name: Dotted-Grid World
effects.description: Continents rendered as illuminated dot clusters over a faint grid — a dotted world map.

effects.name: Rotating Globe
effects.description: A CSS sphere with a scrolling longitude grid — a spinning globe with no assets.

effects.name: Hex-Tile Map
effects.description: A hexagonal tile grid with lit regions — the classic hex-bin territory map.

effects.name: Topographic Relief
effects.description: Concentric contour rings drifting outward from a peak — a stylized elevation map.

effects.name: Day/Night Terminator
effects.description: A soft shadow band sweeps across the map showing the day-night boundary.

effects.name: Drop Pins
effects.description: Teardrop pins that bounce down onto the map in a staggered sequence.

effects.name: Ping Marker
effects.description: A solid location dot emitting expanding rings — a "live here" pulse beacon.

effects.name: Clustered Markers
effects.description: Aggregated marker bubbles sized and counted by density, as when zoomed out.

effects.name: Accuracy Radius
effects.description: A GPS dot inside a breathing accuracy halo showing position uncertainty.

effects.name: Numbered Markers
effects.description: Ordered numbered pins that gently float — for itineraries or ranked stops.

effects.name: You-Are-Here Beacon
effects.description: A bright core with radiating rings and a label — the current-position beacon.

effects.name: Pin with Popup
effects.description: A map pin with a floating info bubble label — the tap-to-reveal callout.

effects.name: Flag Marker
effects.description: A planted, waving flag marker for claiming or highlighting a spot.

effects.name: Great-Circle Arc
effects.description: A curved great-circle path that draws on between two endpoints, then repeats.

effects.name: Multi-Hop Flight Path
effects.description: A dashed, marching multi-leg route connecting several airport stops.

effects.name: Moving Dot Route
effects.description: A glowing dot travels along a fixed route path with a fading motion trail.

effects.name: Shipping Lane
effects.description: An animated dotted sea lane flowing between two ports.

effects.name: Delivery Progress
effects.description: A tracking line filling with green along a route past checkpoint dots.

effects.name: City Route Web
effects.description: A hub-and-spoke network of pulsing links between blinking cities.

effects.name: Round-Trip Arcs
effects.description: Two arcs draw outbound then return, illustrating a round trip between hubs.

effects.name: Waypoint Route
effects.description: A dashed route through start, mid-waypoints and end markers.

effects.name: Choropleth
effects.description: Regions shaded across four intensity tiers — the standard data-density map.

effects.name: Heat Region
effects.description: Layered blurred hotspots blending into a breathing heat blob.

effects.name: Selected Region Glow
effects.description: One region highlighted with a pulsing glow among muted neighbors.

effects.name: Region Fill Sweep
effects.description: A region floods with color left-to-right behind a moving scan bar.

effects.name: Map Legend
effects.description: A choropleth legend with a gradient scale and category swatches.

effects.name: Animated Border
effects.description: A region outline that traces itself around the perimeter, then loops.

effects.name: Density Tiers
effects.description: Stacked per-region density bars rising into place — a compact regional breakdown.

effects.name: Two-Region Compare
effects.description: Side-by-side regions alternating emphasis for an A/B territory comparison.

effects.name: Lat/Long Grid
effects.description: A graticule overlay with highlighted equator and prime meridian.

effects.name: Radar Sweep
effects.description: A rotating sonar sweep with range rings and fading contact blips.

effects.name: Compass Rose
effects.description: A cardinal compass whose needle wavers gently around north.

effects.name: Coordinate HUD
effects.description: A monospace readout of live lat/long, altitude and satellite lock.

effects.name: Scanning Grid
effects.description: A mesh grid with a scan line sweeping down and lit hot cells.

effects.name: Scanning for Signal
effects.description: Concentric waves emitting from a source while searching for a signal.

effects.name: Targeting Crosshair
